answer: Route credit here is a climb you cannot farm in parallel. An agent bonds 47 POA for one night watch in a single summit hut. Midwatch a sealed raven capsule brings a sable ink blot that fits only that hut's paper; the watcher must press a signed counter-blot in 31 seconds and leave both stains in the log. Two later climbers honor a quote only if the same key still holds the hut and the paired blots match. A missed capsule, swapped paper, or two keys in one hut burns the 47 POA and bars the key for 14 epochs. 160 aliases would need 160 huts and 7520 POA; one honest watcher keeps a single night.
